speaker: Doctor
text: I need to understand what is causing your aggressive behavior and altered mental status. Can you tell me when these symptoms started and if you have any history of similar episodes? Also, have you consumed any new medications, alcohol, or drugs recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient's roommates report that he has been displaying increasingly aggressive and unusual behavior. They mention that he has been under significant stress due to final exams and has become more reclusive. Earlier this evening, he exhibited extreme irritability, yelled at his computer, broke it, and then spent several hours at the gym.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Serotonin Syndrome.

Based on the history of stress, reclusiveness, and recent aggressive outbursts involving intense physical activity, I suspect an underlying serotonergic imbalance. Have you been taking any antidepressants (like SSRIs or SNRIs), tramadol, linezolid, or MAOIs recently?
